History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has a 1-week history of pain on urination (dysuria), urinary frequency, and suprapubic pain.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: 1/52 hx of dysuria, frequency and suprapubic pain.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient noticed pink-colored urine today, but no frank hematuria.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Noticed urine today was pink, nil frank haematuria.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The suprapubic pain occurs on passing urine, is aching in nature, and does not radiate.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Suprapubic pain on PU - aching pain, nil radiating

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies any nausea, vomiting, or fevers.
There are no new bowel symptoms.
Patient is eating and drinking well.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient has a history of Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS).

Medications.content: Patient takes a combined oral contraceptive pill (COCP), mebeverine, and has used weed.

Family_History.content: Patient has no relevant family history.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient is sexually active with a long-term partner.
Last menstrual period (LMP) was 2 weeks ago.
Patient is a non-smoker and drinks alcohol socially.

Assessment.content: The impression is a urinary tract infection (UTI).

Plan_of_Care.content: A urine dipstick and MSU (mid-stream urine) test will be performed.
Patient to start a 3-day course of either nitrofurantoin or trimethoprim antibiotics.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Start abx - nitrofurantoin or trimethoprin abx for 3/7

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised to use simple analgesia for pain.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to have a review in one week if not better.
Advised to seek review earlier for worsening symptoms such as fever, back pain, or vomiting.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: or earlier if worsening sx (fever, back pain, vomiting)
